    LargeIndecomposable.RayQuiver.MulBasis.not_zigzag_arm

    Zigzags with a fork and an arm: BO13a figures 5.2 and 5.3 #

    The diagram: two forks out of x p; the zigzag ρ (p+j) (j ≤ L), σ (p+j) (j < L) ending at z (p+L); a vertex M with s' : M → z (p+L); and two leaves at M: v₁ : x (p+L+1) → M and v₂ : M → E. It is an orientation of D̃₂ₗ₊₆ (RayCat.ZA). With v₁ ≫ s' = σ (p+L) it is the diagram of BO13a figure 5.2 (and of figure 5.3).
